questions.question: Write a program that reads a text file and analyzes the frequency of each alphabet letter (a-z). / [CO3]
questions.solution_html: • Write a program that reads a text file and analyzes the frequency of each alphabet letter (a-z). [A]/[CO3] Answer: # Open and read the file filename = ‘example.txt' with open(filename, 'r') as file: text = file.read().lower() # Convert all text to lowercase # Initialize dictionary for letters count = {} for ch in text: if ch.isalpha(): # Count only letters if ch in count: count[ch] += 1 else: count[ch] = 1 # Print letter counts for letter in sorted(count): print(letter, ":", count[letter])

questions.question: Develop a Python program to create a dictionary from two lists: keys = ["id", "name", "age"] values = [101, "Anu", 21]. Display the dictionary and update the `"age"` to 22. / [CO2]
questions.solution_html:
• Develop a Python program to create a dictionary from two lists and update 'age' to 22.
  • [A]/[CO2]
  • Answer:
  • keys = ['id','name','age']
  • values = [101,'Anu',21]
  • # Create empty dictionary
  • my_dict = {}
  • # Add key-value pairs using a loop
  • for i in range(len(keys)):
  • my_dict[keys[i]] = values[i]
  • print("Original Dictionary:", my_dict)
  • # Update 'age' to 22
  • my_dict['age'] = 22
  • print("Updated Dictionary:", my_dict)
  • Output
  • Original Dictionary: {'id': 101, 'name': 'Anu', 'age': 21}
  • Updated Dictionary: {'id': 101, 'name': 'Anu', 'age': 22}
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025
